fix(observ): defer exporter cleanup at shutdown instead of App() return (#2096)

App() builds an http.Handler and returns immediately, so the existing `defer flushTraces()` / `defer flushStats()` fired before the server started listening. This was harmless for Jaeger and Stackdriver (they only flush), but Datadog's Stop() killed the background loop and no
traces or stats were ever exported.

Return a cleanup function from App() and let main() defer it at process level so that every exporter is properly stopped on shutdown.

Additional hardening:
- Wrap cleanup in sync.Once to prevent panic if Stop() is called twice
- Return cleanup (not noop) from post-registration error paths so that
  already-registered exporters are properly stopped on early failure

Closes #1882

Co-authored-by: Nicholas Wiersma <nick@wiersma.co.za>

stash/redis: add cluster-mode client support for singleflight (#2122)

* stash/redis: add cluster-mode client support for singleflight

Athens v0.17.0 singleflight uses redis.NewClient, which can't follow
MOVED/ASK redirects. When the configured endpoint points at a Cluster
Mode Enabled Redis (e.g. AWS ElastiCache's `clustercfg.*` configuration
endpoint), every Stash op that happens to land on a non-slot-owning
node returns MOVED, which the client surfaces as 500 to the caller —
even when the cluster has only one shard, because Cluster Mode replies
MOVED any time the connected node doesn't own the slot for the key.

Add a `Cluster` bool to the SingleFlight.Redis config (env override:
ATHENS_REDIS_CLUSTER). When set, WithRedisLock constructs a
redis.NewClusterClient and stores it in the redisLock as a
redis.UniversalClient — both go-redis client types satisfy the
bsm/redislock RedisClient interface, so the Stash/Release call sites
need no further change. The endpoint may be a single host:port,
redis[s]:// URL, or a comma-separated list of seed addresses; TLS,
username, and embedded passwords are honored the same way the
single-node path honors them.

Backwards compatible: existing configs default to Cluster = false and
keep using redis.NewClient.

Tests:
- new env-gated TestWithRedisClusterLock (REDIS_CLUSTER_TEST_ENDPOINT)
  exercising the cluster-client code path against a real cluster
- new Test_getRedisClusterClientOptions table-test covering host:port,
  multi-seed, rediss://, URL-embedded password validation
- existing single-node tests pass through `false` for the new arg

* remove verbose comments. etc

---------

Co-authored-by: leerieo <leerieo@users.noreply.github.com>

Replace logrus with log/slog (#2127)

* replace logrus with log/slog

Keep the pkg/log Entry interface as-is and implement it on top of
log/slog so the call sites that use it don't change. logrus drops from a
direct dependency to indirect (etcd's embedded server still pulls it in
transitively).

- pkg/errors: Severity is now slog.Level with an explicit unset sentinel,
  since slog's zero value is a real level (Info)
- pkg/log: custom dev handler plus GCP/JSON handlers; ParseLevel maps the
  legacy logrus level names so existing configs keep working
- GCP still emits severity/message/timestamp so Cloud Logging routing is
  unchanged

Refs #2010
Fixes #1890

* fix lint

- log.go: blank line after embedded field (embeddedstructfieldcheck);
  use slog.DiscardHandler for the no-op logger (sloglint)
- index.go: move log/slog into the stdlib import group (gci)
- main.go: use logger.Fatalf instead of Errorf + os.Exit so the exit
  stays behind a method, matching the old logrus.Fatal (gocritic
  exitAfterDefer)

fix: add DB parameter to Redis Sentinel SingleFlight configuration (#2107) (#2125)

This change adds a 'DB' field to the RedisSentinel SingleFlight configuration,
allowing users to specify a redis database number when using sentinels.
This matches the capability existing in the standard Redis SingleFlight config.

- Added 'DB' field to config.RedisSentinel struct with envconfig 'ATHENS_REDIS_SENTINEL_DB'.
- Updated stash.WithRedisSentinelLock to accept and use the db parameter.
- Updated proxy action to propagate the DB value from config.
- Updated default configuration, examples, and tests.
- Added documentation for the new parameter.
- Fixed a regression in app_proxy.go where an incorrect checker was used.

Co-authored-by: Matt <matt.ouille@protonmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Nicholas Wiersma <nick@wiersma.co.za>

Revert in-process subprocess reaper, rely on tini (#2137)

The reaper added in #2043 calls Wait4(-1) on SIGCHLD, which races os/exec
and can reap a child before os/exec waits on it. When that happens Run()
returns "no child processes" instead of the exit code, surfacing as spurious
404s (#2049). #2048 only hid the symptom and lost the exit status.

Revert both. Orphaned toolchain processes (go, git, ssh) are reaped by the
init at PID 1, which is tini in the official image (#1155). Keep the
NotifyContext shutdown handling from #2043, warn when running as PID 1 with
no init, and document the requirement.

Fixes #2049

Signed-off-by: Matt Ouille <matt.ouille@protonmail.com>

Replace OpenCensus with OpenTelemetry (#2138)

* Replace OpenCensus with OpenTelemetry

OpenCensus is deprecated. Migrate pkg/observ to OpenTelemetry natively
instead of using the bridge (#1891).

- Traces export over OTLP (gRPC). TraceExporter is now an otlp/empty
  toggle; the URL default moves from :14268 to :4317 and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*
  env vars are honored when it's empty.
- Metrics go through an OTel MeterProvider with a Prometheus reader on the
  same /metrics route. The three custom metrics keep their names (proxy_
  prefix included). HTTP metrics come from otelhttp now, so those names
  change to the semconv names.
- ochttp.Handler/Transport become otelhttp; stasher.go's trace.NewContext
  becomes trace.ContextWithSpan.
- jaeger/datadog/stackdriver are dropped. An unsupported exporter logs a
  message and Athens boots without it, same as before.
- Drop go.opencensus.io and the contrib exporters; promote the OTel SDK
  from indirect to direct.

Fixes #1771

* Update tracing docs and compose for OTLP

The observability FAQ still described the old Jaeger/Stackdriver/Datadog
exporters and a walkthrough that won't capture traces now that Athens
speaks OTLP.

- Rewrite the FAQ section around OTLP and note metrics live on /metrics.
- Point the dev compose service at the Jaeger OTLP endpoint and enable
  Jaeger's OTLP receiver (ports 4317/4318).
- Drop the datadog agent service; it's unused now that the Datadog
  exporter is gone.

* Make trace sampling configurable outside development

The non-dev sampler was ParentBased(AlwaysSample), so production sampled
every root span — a behavior change from OpenCensus, which sampled a small
fraction by default. Add a knob instead of hardcoding it.

- New ATHENS_TRACE_SAMPLING_FRACTION (TraceSamplingFraction), 0.0 to 1.0,
  defaulting to 1.0. Outside development the root sampler is
  ParentBased(TraceIDRatioBased(fraction)); development still always samples.
- Document it in config.dev.toml and the testdata fixture.

* Align struct tags to satisfy tagalign linter
